title: On the Brunn-Minkowski inequality for $q$-th dual quermassintegrals with $q>n$
summary: In this paper, we study the Brunn-Minkowski inequality for $q$-th dual quermassintegrals with $q>n$. This problem was recently posed by Sadovsky and Zhang. First, by a second variation argument and a dimension reduction construction, we show that the inequality fails for arbitrary convex bodies when $q>n$, and fails even in the origin-symmetric class when $q>n+2$. Secondly, we prove the endpoint case $q=n+2$ for origin-symmetric convex bodies via Hadwiger's inequality for the polar moment of inertia.
